I compete seriously and have finished near the top” vs “ongoing practice in offensive technique”","dimension":"offensive security intensity","description":"This captures how strongly the letter presents hands-on competitive offensive-security practice.","winner":"A"},{"evidence":"“open source, where I regularly send patches upstream” vs “designed and implemented a sharded time-series database”","dimension":"side project orientation","description":"This captures the kind of work outside the core job used to demonstrate initiative, whether community contribution or a personal build project.","winner":"B"},{"evidence":"“Go as the language I have used most” vs “primarily in Go alongside 2 other languages”","dimension":"Go prominence","description":"This captures how central Go is presented within the applicant’s language experience for the back-end systems in the role.","winner":"A"}]}
